patthana8.63:1.1: dhammaṃ paṭicca na sappītiko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
patthana8.63:2.1: na apapitikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na appītiko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
patthana8.63:3.1: na sappītikañca na appītikañca dhammaṃ paṭicca na sappītiko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā nava, na pītisahagataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na pītisahagato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. tīṇi. na
